_evidence: 0x0051620d: 'mov esi,[0x679d30]; call 0x40814e; jae; mov eax,1; mov [0xa6987c],eax'. 0x40814e reads the stamp dword [esi+0x1d4] ('test ..,-1; je' -> clc) and otherwise 'neg eax; add eax,[0x66d814]; jns' (CF = race clock minus stamp negative). With ptr_00679d30 the stamp was a random dword and the clock 0x66d814 (read only by the callee) kept its image value, so the expiry test never compared realistic times. Buffer part: a 0x41c-byte car record of random bytes with the stamp +0x1d4 drawn from zero (not stamped), times inside the clock_0066d814 range 0..0x10000 (both sides of the clock) and sign-boundary values. Global part: [0x679d30] points at such a record (the selected car; any separate record is valid, nothing else is dereferenced). Compose as fuzz:i32+layout=clock_0066d814+stamp_0051620d.
